title: Peculiar Creatures
description: Adds peculiar creatures to minecraft using polymer
body:
### Requires Polymer and Notica Read how [polymer](https://modrinth.com/mod/polymer) and [polymer auto host](https://polymer.pb4.eu/latest/user/resource-pack-hosting/) works first. If the resource pack is disabled, the items will use vanilla textures and entities will turn into their vanilla counterparts.
(e.g. smurfcat turns into a small zombie with smurfcat player head and white and blue leather armor)
Music discs are played using [notica](https://modrinth.com/mod/notica) wich allows them to be completely server side. --- ### Content This mod adds creatures that you wouldn't have expected to be in minecraft, completely server sided. What's in the mod currently:
Spoiler * Smurfcat * Smurfish Cap * Spectre Music Disc * Ogre Home Structure * Ogre * Ear of the Ogre * All Star Music Disc
--- ### Planned
Spoiler * Sky Bison using https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/appa-ghasts as model
